# UFC Fight Predictions

## SVM Model

### Preparation
```{r}
library(kernlab)
library(caret)

ufc_model <- readRDS("ufc_model.rds")
labels <- ufc_model$Winner
predictors <- ufc_model[, !names(ufc_model) %in% c("Winner", "R_fighter", "B_fighter")]

# Same filtering as the KNN file, so both models use the same fights
keep <- complete.cases(predictors) & labels %in% c("Red", "Blue")
predictors <- droplevels(predictors[keep, ])
labels <- droplevels(labels[keep])

x <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = predictors)

minmax <- function(v) {
  r <- range(v)
  if (r[2] == r[1]) return(rep(0, length(v)))
  (v - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
}
x_scaled <- as.data.frame(apply(x, 2, minmax))

# Add the outcome back as a factor
svm_data <- data.frame(x_scaled, Winner = labels)

# Same split as the KNN file
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(svm_data), 0.7 * nrow(svm_data))
ufc_train <- svm_data[train_rows, ]
ufc_test  <- svm_data[-train_rows, ]
```

### Build Model
```{r}
#ufc_test <- as.factor(ufc_test)
#ufc_train <- as.factor(ufc_train)

library(kernlab)
svm.model <- ksvm(Winner ~ ., data = ufc_train, kernel = "vanilladot")
svm.model

# Predict using only predictor columns
svm.pred <- predict(svm.model, ufc_test[, names(ufc_test) != "Winner"])
```

### Evaluate Model
```{r}
all_levels <- c("Red", "Blue")
confusionMatrix(factor(svm.pred, levels = all_levels),
                factor(ufc_test$Winner, levels = all_levels),
                positive = "Red")
```
